heading: Where I’ve been

roles.title: Systems Engineer
roles.metricLabel: business users on the services I build and run
roles.summary: Modernising an enterprise Quote & Bind platform: moving JSF modules to Angular 17 and building the Spring Boot APIs behind them.
highlights: Designed and built 50+ Spring Boot REST APIs with layered architecture, validation, exception handling and reusable service components.
Led the Java 11 → 17 and TomEE 8 → 10 migration, working through compatibility, configuration and deployment issues.
Secured enterprise access with Okta, OAuth2, JWT and role-based access control across the API surface.
Integrated Splunk logging and monitoring so production issues get found in minutes, not mornings.
Kept critical JSP, JSF, Servlet and EJB insurance workflows healthy while the new stack took shape.

roles.title: Senior Systems Engineer
roles.metricLabel: micro frontends, independently built and deployed
roles.summary: Migrated legacy financial application modules toward Angular and Spring Boot, cutting technical debt one module at a time.
highlights: Implemented a micro frontend architecture with Single-SPA so teams could ship modules independently.
Designed reusable Angular components and REST integrations for enterprise financial applications.
Built CMS-to-API integration layers that simplified configuration and data flows.
Applied RxJS and centralised error handling for reliable frontend-to-backend communication.
Raised regression coverage with Jasmine and Karma unit tests, and supported CI/CD releases.
